notes: Official page is titled '2025 Full-time MBA Class Profile' (fall 2025 entering class, i.e. Class of 2027); all class profile figures replace the prior Clear Admit sourcing. GRE published only as a combined average of 318 (39 pct took GRE); no quant/verbal split. Acceptance rate not published; not derived from applications vs enrolled. Class of 2025 employment release gives average base salary 146265 and average signing bonus 33768 but no overall median; the 2025 median would be in the flipbook employment report, which would not load (see _failures), so the Class of 2024 official median 148000 is recorded instead.
